# Soundemote

> Soundemote builds analog-emulation instruments and signal-reactive visual tools for electronic music producers and VJs. The site hosts our open-source audio-visual DSP projects, an in-browser modular sandbox, patch pages, and a wiki of DSP articles.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured DSP article, hero sandbox, and project constellation.
- [Sandbox](/sandbox): In-browser modular audio-visual DSP sandbox.
- [Wiki](/wiki): Index of DSP and audio-visual articles.
- [Webring](/webring): Links to friends and adjacent creative-tech projects.
- [Changelog](/changelog): Notable updates to Soundemote projects.

## Articles

- [SIMD](/simd): SIMD-friendly DSP programming.
- [Aliasing Wars](/aliasingwars): The ongoing war against digital aliasing.
- [Phosphor](/phosphor): CRT phosphor visual emulation.
- [Analog Filters](/analogfilters): Analog-modeled filter designs.
- [Vactrols](/vactrols): Light-based analog envelope hardware.
- [Synthwave Orchestra](/synthwaveorchestra): Robin Schmidt's supersaw research.
- [Archimedes](/archimedes): Spiral-based generative oscillator.
- [Combustion](/combustion): Chaotic combustion-model synthesis.

## Patches

- [Reverb](/reverb): Sabrina reverb patch in the sandbox.
- [Shooting Star](/shootingstar): Chaos generator with a shooting-star explosion.
